name: 1D Packing Isomorphism
description: Transforms the algebraic system of multiplicative inequalities into a formally equivalent 1D geometric packing problem using midpoints. The variables $U$ and $V$ become the start and end coordinates of intervals, represented by their center $M$. The multiplicative scaling becomes an additive length constraint, and the cross-index constraints become an absolute-difference non-overlapping condition. This eliminates the explicit power-of-two equations and the recognizable $V_1 \cdot V_2 \le 2^T$ form, forcing the model to deduce the local and global bottlenecks from geometric capacity semantics rather than matching the algebraic shortcut.
